title: Optimal Competitive Ratios for Chasing Convex Functions with Quadratic Growth
abstract: arXiv:2611.08078v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Chasing convex function has attracted much attention in recent years, which can be formulated as a game between a learner and an adversary. In each round, the adversary reveals a convex function, and the learner selects a decision and incurs a hitting cost and a movement cost for changing its decision. The performance of the learner is measured by the \emph{competitive ratio}, which compares its cumulative cost with that of an optimal offline decision sequence. For Euclidean movement, existing upper and lower bounds for $\kappa$-well-conditioned functions exhibit a polynomial gap. For squared Euclidean movement, dimension-free competitive guarantees have been established under quadratic growth, but the optimal competitive ratio remains unclear. translated_title: 二次增长条件下追逐凸函数问题的最优竞争比
translated_abstract: 追逐凸函数问题近年来备受关注，它可以被形式化为学习者和对抗者之间的博弈。在每一轮中，对抗者揭示一个凸函数，学习者选择一个决策，并因此产生命中成本和改变决策所带来的移动成本。学习者的性能通过竞争比来衡量，即将其累积成本与最优离线决策序列的累积成本进行比较。对于欧几里得移动成本，现有针对 κ-良态函数的上下界之间存在多项式级别的差距。对于平方欧几里得移动成本，虽然已在二次增长条件下建立了无维度依赖的竞争保证，但最优竞争比仍不明确。在本文中，我们针对两种类型的移动成本下的凸函数追逐问题建立了最优的无维度依赖竞争比。对于欧几里得移动成本，我们提出了裁剪近端下降算法（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文针对具有二次增长的凸函数追逐问题，在欧几里得移动和平方欧几里得移动两种成本类型下建立了最优的无维度依赖竞争比，弥补了已有上下界之间的多项式差距。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes optimal dimension-free competitive ratios for chasing convex functions with quadratic growth under both Euclidean and squared Euclidean movement costs, closing the polynomial gap between existing upper and lower bounds.
